Acceptance criteria:
- AC1: The same `(connection_id, scan_id, params_hash, schema_fingerprint, day)` returns the existing run (200), not a new one.
- AC2: A second scan on a connection with one running is queued, never run in parallel.
- AC3: An area that raises is stored as failed with a plain cause; other areas complete; the run ends `partial`.
- AC4: Findings persist `sample_ids` (≤ 20) and counts only: a test inspects stored JSON keys against an allow-list and finds no field values.
- AC5: Jobs use the existing queue in `app/jobs.py`; no second job runner.
